text_excerpt: Unleash Therapeutics, LLC 0 Immunotherapy for canine cancer . Intro In partnership with Ardent Animal Health , we are developing a dual-action immunotherapy for canine osteosarcoma. Osteosarcoma accounts for 85% of bone tumors in dogs and carries a median survival time of less than one year with standard treatment. By applying validated human cancer science, our dual-action immunotherapy is designed to improve outcomes for one of the most common and lethal cancers in dogs. Program Indication : Canine osteosarcoma Mechanism of action : A dual-action immunotherapy combining an autologous vaccine (K9-ACV) with a novel checkpoint inhibitor (CD200AR-L) to stimulate a robust anti-tumor immune response Origin : The novel checkpoint inhibitor (CD200AR-L) is based on research from the University of Minnesota, with companion animal rights licensed to Unleash Therapeutics, LLC (via OX2 Therapeutics). Partner : Ardent Animal Health - the dual-action immunotherapy combines our novel checkpoint inhibitor with Ardent’s existing autologous cancer vaccine (K9-ACV), and will be commercialized under the Ardent Animal Health brand. Status : Clinical - we are conducting a multi-center randomized field
